responsibility: This file implements the D frontend’s target abstraction on top of GCC target data and hooks. It initializes the frontend `Target` structure from GCC ABI properties such as pointer size, C integer and floating layouts, object-file conventions, and calling-convention capabilities; exposes C++ ABI helpers and mangling-related queries; answers `__traits(getTargetInfo)` through extensible target-info handler tables; and defines D semantic policies that depend on target behavior, such as `extern(System)` linkage, return-on-stack heuristics, callee-destroys-args, and pass-by-ref preferences.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable implementation of D target semantics and queries on top of GCC target data; unlike d-target.def, which merely lists hook kinds and defaults, and d-target.h, which materializes the hook structures and declarations, this file computes Target properties and answers target-dependent frontend policy questions.
